name: How do I choose the right real estate agent to help sell my house before foreclosure?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right real estate agent to help sell my house before foreclosure?

acceptedAnswer.text: When facing foreclosure, choose an agent with specific experience in pre-foreclosure sales, short sales, and navigating lender negotiations. Look for someone with strong local market knowledge and a proven track record of successful transactions in distressed situations. Kelby Contreras and Realty ONE Group Evolution bring extensive experience in Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach Counties, offering the specialized expertise required for these time-sensitive and complex sales.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an agent with experience in pre-foreclosure sales, short sales, lender negotiations, and strong local market knowledge.
